reason: The QR encoder requires numeric output geometry and black-on-white encoded artwork. Inline width, height, visibility and its offscreen SVG conversion host belong to the generated image.
Third-party token and network artwork uses numeric image sizes and an overlapping network mark. Theme roles style the surrounding presentation.
Extension-owned image URLs retain provider artwork with an accessible generic fallback.
The deployment logo and three explicit header controls use responsive image bounds and horizontal placement.
The page owns responsive column ordering and viewport/container bounds. Spacing and appearance come from central recipes.
The activity schema owns column widths, responsive column visibility and truncation. Table primitives own density and interaction.
